interaction: Scroll through a sunrise: the page moves from dawn navy through magenta and orange to morning cream while a sun rises behind the content, and each manifesto line 'wakes up' as it reaches the middle of the screen — its Recursive weight, slant, casual axis and scale all tied to its scroll position; the four value cards flip over on click, tap or keyboard.
notes: With reduced motion the manifesto is set statically in bold upright type over the same gradient; resource buttons show a demo toast instead of downloading.
